rg -rn foo src
sleep 90
sleep 45
make run &
nohup x
pkill -f node
git add -A
git add -uv
git reset --hard
find . -name x
cat /home/test/notes.txt
grep foo a b
ls /nix/store
nixos-rebuild switch
echo x > /home/test/new.txt
ssh host "sleep 5 &"
for x in a b; echo $x; end
bwrap --ro-bind / / bash -c 'pkill -f x'
env -S 'pkill -f x'
git push git@github.com:ElXreno/nixos-config.git main
